summary: Verified print preview bug fix in VoucherKu app. Both CreateVoucher ('Cetak Semua') and VoucherManagement (print icon per voucher) flows now render the print template correctly when print media is emulated. The print template is fixed-positioned, visible, and contains all required content (VoucherKu header, QR code image, voucher code, nominal amount, title, terms, expiry date) formatted for 80mm thermal printer.
critical_code_review_comments: CreateVoucher.js handlePrint fires window.print() immediately after setCreatedVouchers has already committed state, which is fine. But VoucherManagement.js relies on a 100ms setTimeout after setSelectedVoucher(); this is fragile - if React hasn't rendered by 100ms, the template will be missing. Consider using useEffect on selectedVoucher change to trigger print, or a state flag like `shouldPrint`.
Both files duplicate an ~35-line print template markup and formatCurrency helper. Extract into a shared <PrintVoucher voucher={...} /> component to satisfy DRY.

index.css: The `body *` visibility:hidden + fixed-positioning override is a workable pattern, but printing directly on the app page can miss elements outside the print-area (e.g., toasts). Consider using a dedicated print window (window.open + document.write) for more reliable thermal printing across browsers.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test vouchers via CreateVoucher form (title 'Print Test Voucher', nominal 50000, qty 2). One earlier voucher 'Test Voucher Baru' also present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Print preview verified via Playwright emulate_media('print'). Print template renders correctly with 80mm width, position:fixed, visibility:visible. QR images load. All required fields present. Bug is fixed. The 100ms setTimeout in VoucherManagement.handlePrint is a minor risk on slower devices but did not fail in tests.
rca of the issue: Root cause of original empty print preview: the print template was hidden with Tailwind `hidden print:block` classes, but the global `body *` visibility:hidden rule (previously present or interaction with modal overlays) combined with non-fixed positioning caused the template to be effectively invisible or clipped in the print viewport. Fix applied: (a) `.print-area` and `.print-voucher` now use position:fixed at 0,0 with 80mm width and z-index:99999, (b) explicit visibility:visible overrides on template and its descendants, (c) inline styles on template markup so print CSS defeats hidden-by-default. Reproduction: emulate print media in Playwright, inspect [data-testid='print-area'] visibility and bbox. Post-fix bbox is non-empty (302px width, 706px height for 2 vouchers) and inner_text contains all required content.
